wk25r.description: New HPO with the roll-out objective against the exact parameter-free solution (as described in the paper: 60 trials x 200 epochs, pilot set 300x3000 / 400x100 / 400x300, lr 1e-4..1e-3, 128 chains x 10 steps, no mass-conservation projection, no PyBaMM), then one seed trained with the wk25c recipe (lr decay over 1000 epochs, early stopping after it, L-BFGS), scored on the paper's protocol

wk25rcv.description: Cross-validation of the wk25r network (64 x 7 SiLU from the roll-out HPO runs/hpo_rollout_wk25r): seeds 43-45 with exactly the wk25r recipe; num_batches fixed to the 32 that autotune chose for wk25r_s42. Seed 42 is wk25r_s42 in study wk25r.
